newsitem.title: USA: Biofield breast device not accepted by FDA.
newsitem.headline: Biofield breast device not accepted by FDA.

text.p: Biofield Corp said late Thursday that the Food and Drug Administration has rejected its premarket approval application for the ALEXA breast cancer diagnosis device.
The company said the FDA wants it to address deficiences in the algorithms supporting data included in its application.

The company said in a release it is "confident in the findings of its multi-center study conducted at six major medical institutions in the United States and intends to work closely with the FDA to advance the (application) process."
